panels.rationale: Single clinical photo of eruptive nodular verruga peruana rash in 3-year-old boy with Carrion disease; caption and in-text describe classic eruptive nodular rash visibly shown as red papulonodular lesions.

panels.figure_caption: Clinical presentation of verruga peruana in 3-year-old boy, Peru, 2003.
in_text_mentions: The patient was a 3-year-old boy with no known underlying medical history who was identified in 2003 as having clinical verruga peruana by the classic appearance of the eruptive nodular rash (Figure 1). He and his family lived in a rural setting near the town of Caraz, Ancash region, Peru. He lived in close proximity to numerous pets and farm animals and had experienced insect bites around the time the eruptive rash developed.
